responsibility: Implements GCC’s main gimplification pass that lowers front-end GENERIC trees into High GIMPLE function bodies. It owns the gimplify context stack, statement and expression lowering routines, temporary creation and sharing logic, body/function conversion, built-in and special-form lowering such as va_arg, instrumentation wrapping, cleanup handling, and substantial OpenMP/OpenACC clause and region preparation, producing structured GIMPLE sequences that later low-GIMPLE, CFG, and SSA passes consume.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of GCC's main gimplifier that lowers entire GENERIC trees and function bodies into GIMPLE, including context management and language/OpenMP/OpenACC lowering; this differs from gcc/gimplify-me.cc, which only regimplifies or repairs operands after transformations, and from gcc/gimplify.h, which declares the public interface.
